title: The supported constant comparison mate is invertible
statement: For a commutative ring A and a closed immersion i:D→Z, the specified geoCartierSourceComparison [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface] is invertible.

source.place: Paragraph 1: identify the source by the canonical comparison mate

proof.text: A closed immersion is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The ordinary closed-image comparison mate is invertible by the direct-image comparison theorem; compose it with direct image of the constant-sheaf comparison isomorphism. This composite is the specified source map.
